bb.name: Amp
bb.description: Registers Amp as a custom ACP provider in bb through a bundled ACP bridge built on the official @ampcode/sdk.

scripts.build:bridge: esbuild src/bridge.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=esm --target=node20 --outfile=dist/bridge.js --banner:js="import { createRequire as __bbCreateRequire } from 'node:module'; const require = __bbCreateRequire(import.meta.url);"
scripts.build: bun run build:bridge && bb plugin build .
